dialogue.content: おはようございます。時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きたいと思います。本日はよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good morning. It's time to begin our session. Thank you for being here today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします🙇
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: おはようございます。本日は相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。始めに、年齢、性別、ご相談内容を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you tell me your age, gender, and what brings you here?

dialogue.content: おはようございます。40才女です夫が、何でも私のせいにしてくるので、離婚したいです。
dialogue.English: Good morning. I’m a 40-year-old woman. My husband blames me for everything, so I want a divorce.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何あなたのせいにされるのは嫌ですよね
dialogue.English: It must be upsetting to be blamed for everything.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 腹が立ちます
dialogue.English: It makes me angry.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。例えばどのような事であなたのせいにされるのですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. For example, what kinds of things does he blame you for?

dialogue.content: 話せる範囲で大丈夫ですのでお聞かせください
dialogue.English: Please feel free to share only what you're comfortable with.

dialogue.content: 仕事に遅刻することも、職場に恵まれないこともやりたいことがうまくできないことも
dialogue.English: Things like when he's late for work, is unhappy with his job, or when things he wants to do don't go well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 全部、私のせいだそうです
dialogue.English: According to him, it's all my fault.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それは納得がいかないのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see. That must feel unreasonable to you.

dialogue.content: そういわれてどのように思われたのですか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when he said that?

dialogue.content: 結婚してすぐに妊娠して、ちょっと不安定な時期に彼の夢をあきらめてほしいと、私が言ったことがありまして
dialogue.English: Right after we got married, I became pregnant, and during that somewhat unstable time, I once asked him to give up on his dream.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 結果、夢を果たせなかったのは私のせいだと
dialogue.English: As a result, he says that it's my fault he couldn't fulfill his dream.

dialogue.content: ずっと今も言ってる感じです
dialogue.English: He still says it all the time, even now.

dialogue.content: 私のせいなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it really my fault?

dialogue.content: いえいえ、妊娠中の時期は心もふあんていですし、新しい事が、
dialogue.English: No, not at all. During pregnancy, it’s natural to feel emotionally unstable, and when new things—

dialogue.content: 始まることも、不安なのでそう思われたのも当然だったのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: are beginning, it’s normal to feel anxious, so it’s understandable that you felt that way.

dialogue.content: それを今も言われるのは、お辛いと感じました
dialogue.English: Being told that even now sounds very painful.

dialogue.content: 今、旦那さまのことをどう思われているのですか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about your husband now?

dialogue.content: 本当に夢を叶えたいなら、私の一回の発言であきらめないと私は思います
dialogue.English: If he truly wanted to achieve his dream, I don’t think he would have given up because of one comment I made.

dialogue.content: 今はもう子どもの父親としかみていません
dialogue.English: Now, I only see him as the father of my children.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。それを言われたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Have you ever told him that?

dialogue.content: あります。
dialogue.English: Yes, I have.

dialogue.content: 勇気がいると思いましたが、その時どのように思われましたか？
dialogue.English: I imagine that took courage. What was his reaction then?

dialogue.content: 『自分でいっておいて、人生を変えておいて、人間性じゃない❗』みたいなことを言ってました。もう、私とは話したくないとも
dialogue.English: He said something like, "You said it yourself and changed my life—that’s not what a decent person would do!" He also said he doesn’t want to talk to me anymore.

dialogue.content: そう言われたのですね
dialogue.English: So that's what he said to you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは、なかなか辛い言葉と感じられましたが、いかがですか？？
dialogue.English: Those are quite hurtful words. How was that for you?

dialogue.content: 離れたいと思います
dialogue.English: I think I want to separate.

dialogue.content: 考え方が違うから無理だと思ってます
dialogue.English: I don't think it can work because we think so differently.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。そう思われるのも無理もないと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. It’s completely understandable that you feel that way.

dialogue.content: 旦那様は納得しそうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think your husband would agree to it?

dialogue.content: 夫婦だけならすぐにでもできます
dialogue.English: If it were just the two of us, we could do it right away.

dialogue.content: 子どもは、まだ父親を求めている時期で
dialogue.English: But the children are still at an age where they need their father.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。お子様はおいくつですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How old are your children?

dialogue.content: 9さい6さいです
dialogue.English: They’re 9 and 6.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。それはお子様の事を考えると悩んでしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Thank you. That must make it a very difficult decision when you think about your children.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お二人事お子様は何か気づいていますか？
dialogue.English: Are your children aware of what's going on between you two?

dialogue.content: ケンカや言い合いはしてるので
dialogue.English: Well, we do have fights and arguments.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: わかっています
dialogue.English: So they know.

dialogue.content: 喧嘩も見ていてわかっているのですね
dialogue.English: They see the fights and understand, don't they?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ずっと我慢して子どもが寝てからケンカしたりしていましたが
dialogue.English: I used to hold it in and we'd fight after the children were asleep,

dialogue.content: やめました
dialogue.English: but I stopped doing that.

dialogue.content: なるほど。我慢されていたけど我慢できなくなった感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Was it that you were holding back, but you just couldn't anymore?

dialogue.content: ですね、あとは、子どもたちも分かるようになってきたので学んでほしいとも思っています
dialogue.English: Yes, that's part of it. Also, now that the children are old enough to understand, I want them to learn from this.

dialogue.content: そう思われているのですね
dialogue.English: So that's how you're thinking about it.

dialogue.content: 私はそう思っています
dialogue.English: That's what I believe.

dialogue.content: もし離婚するのであれば、何か準備とかも考えているのですか？
dialogue.English: If you were to get a divorce, are you thinking about any preparations?

dialogue.content: お金さえあればいいと思っています
dialogue.English: I think as long as we have enough money, we’ll be okay.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。あなたは、もう心が決まっているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you already made up your mind?

dialogue.content: 決まっていますが
dialogue.English: I have, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: まだ先かと
dialogue.English: I think it's still some time away.

dialogue.content: そう思われているのですね。
dialogue.English: That’s how you see it.

dialogue.content: いや、離婚じゃなく別居かと
dialogue.English: Well, not a divorce, but maybe a separation.

dialogue.content: まとめさせていただきますと
dialogue.English: So, if I could summarize...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 昔、あなたに夢をあきらめさせられたと思っている旦那さまが、気に入らないことがあると
dialogue.English: Your husband believes you made him give up his dream long ago, and when something displeases him,

dialogue.content: すべてあなたのせいにするので、嫌になっているという事でしょうか？
dialogue.English: he blames everything on you, and you've grown tired of it. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: 何でも、自分のせいにされて、本当にイラつくのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It must be truly infuriating to be blamed for everything.

dialogue.content: 怒りと不信感ですね
dialogue.English: It’s anger and distrust.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。もう昔の事で、妊娠中で不安だったあなたの事をもっとわかって欲しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's something from a long time ago, and you want him to understand more about how you were feeling, being pregnant and anxious back then.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その怒りはどこからきていると思っていましたか？
dialogue.English: Where did you think that anger was coming from?

dialogue.content: んー
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 旦那様にどうして欲しいと思われていましたか？
dialogue.English: What did you want from your husband?

dialogue.content: なぜ、彼が人のせいにするのか
dialogue.English: Why does he blame other people...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ずっと考えてみましたが、育ちなどもあると思いました
dialogue.English: I've thought about it a lot, and I think it might have to do with his upbringing.

dialogue.content: あと
dialogue.English: And also—

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 人のせいにしておけば、自分は考えなくて良いから？
dialogue.English: if he blames others, he doesn't have to think for himself?

dialogue.content: 基本、考えることが乏しい人だと感じます
dialogue.English: Fundamentally, I feel he's a person who doesn't think things through deeply.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そう思われているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's your impression of him.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: あなたの思う考え方が乏しくない人はどのような人ですか？
dialogue.English: In your view, what is a person who does think things through like?

dialogue.content: 自分の考えがあって言語化できる人かな
dialogue.English: I guess someone who has their own thoughts and can put them into words.

dialogue.content: コミュニケーションを取ろうとする気持ちが伝わってくる人
dialogue.English: Someone whose willingness to communicate comes across.

dialogue.content: なるほど。旦那様にもっと気持ちを言って欲しいと思われていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. You would like your husband to express his feelings more, is that right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I do.

dialogue.content: 普段の会話もずっとせめてくる感じなのでしょうか？？
dialogue.English: In your daily conversations, does he always seem to be attacking you?

dialogue.content: 攻めてくるよりは私を避けようとしている感じです
dialogue.English: It feels less like he's attacking me and more like he's trying to avoid me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。避けれているという事ですが、もっとどうして欲しいと思われていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned he's avoiding you; what would you rather he do?

dialogue.content: 口数が少なくても、コミュニケーションを楽しもうとか自分の考えを伝えてきてほしいと
dialogue.English: Even if he doesn't talk much, I wish he would try to enjoy communication or share his thoughts.

dialogue.content: そう思われているのですね。はやり会話はだいじですよね
dialogue.English: I understand. Conversation is indeed important, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 言葉で気持ちを伝えてもらわないと何を考えているのか、通じなですものね
dialogue.English: If he doesn't express his feelings in words, you can't understand what he's thinking, right?

dialogue.content: 通じないです
dialogue.English: It doesn't get through.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: あなたは自分気持ちを旦那様にどのように伝えていますか？
dialogue.English: How do you communicate your own feelings to your husband?

dialogue.content: 一時期は頑張って伝えて、頑張って待っていましたが
dialogue.English: For a while, I tried hard to communicate and waited patiently,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: どんなことも私のせいになるので
dialogue.English: but everything ends up being my fault,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 最近は、事務的なことしか伝えていません
dialogue.English: so lately, I only talk to him about practical matters.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。いっても伝わらない時はどう思われていましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. How did you feel when you tried to talk but couldn't get through to him?

dialogue.content: 悲しみや孤独を感じました
dialogue.English: I felt sad and lonely.

dialogue.content: そう思われてたのですね
dialogue.English: I can see why you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: でも、子どもたちを育てたいので
dialogue.English: But, I want to raise my children...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 反面教師で学んでほしいと今は思ってます
dialogue.English: so now I'm hoping they learn from his bad example.

dialogue.content: 反面教師とは？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by “negative example”?

dialogue.content: 考える力を育ててあげようと努力しています
dialogue.English: I'm trying to help them develop the ability to think for themselves.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: しっかりと自分の意見を言える人がいいと思われて思われているのですね
dialogue.English: You think it's good for them to become people who can firmly express their own opinions.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: とても向き合いたいと思っているのに通じない淋しさが伝わってきました。でもおこさまの
dialogue.English: I can sense the loneliness that comes from wanting to connect but not being able to. But for your children,

dialogue.content: ための頑張っていられるのですね
dialogue.English: you’re able to keep trying.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今思えば彼は付き合ったときから、そういう人でした
dialogue.English: Thank you. Looking back, he's been that kind of person since we were dating.

dialogue.content: 私が変わったのかも
dialogue.English: Maybe I’m the one who changed.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。年月がたてば誰でも変わると思います。
dialogue.English: I see. I think everyone changes as the years go by.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 母親になり考え方が男性よりも
dialogue.English: Becoming a mother changes your way of thinking, perhaps more so than a man's,

dialogue.content: 変わるのは当然のことで、人間的に成長されたのだ感じました。
dialogue.English: so it's natural for it to change, and I feel that you've grown as a person.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間ですが、お話されていかがですか？
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up. How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます今の自分が私は良いと思っています
dialogue.English: Thank you. I think I'm okay with the person I am now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。あなたの信じる道を歩んでくださいね
dialogue.English: Thank you. Please continue to follow the path you believe in.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。またお話に来てくださいね。終了しますがよろしいですか？？
dialogue.English: Thank you, too. Please feel free to come and talk again. Is it okay if we conclude our session now?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。はい
dialogue.English: Thank you. Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: では、失礼いたします。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Well then, goodbye. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: （クライエント役ありがとうございました。また注意点などよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for playing the client role. Please let me know if you have any feedback.)

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
